name: Buttah Skin
description: Skincare brand founded in 2018 by Dorion Renaud, uniting nature and science in products for women and men targeting dryness, discoloration, oiliness and blemishes, with a strong creator and TikTok presence.

contacts.notes: The brand's own Creators & Partnerships page invites creators to apply for product and collaboration review.

evidence.summary: Buttah Skin's Awin merchant profile (fetched, merchant ID 97999) runs its affiliate program on Awin with a 90-day attribution period; the profile does not publish the commission rate in its public text.

The Lasso affiliate directory lists the Buttah Skin program at 20% per sale with a 30-day cookie; the rate is directory-reported because the Awin profile itself does not print it. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Buttah Skin's own Creators & Partnerships page invites creators to apply for product and collaboration invitations; the brand is heavily creator-led on TikTok (@buttahskin), where an estimated 84% of its TikTok Shop sales in the 30 days to Nov 6, 2026 came through affiliate creators (Rateful estimate). The recorded route into the directory is the Awin program, not TikTok Shop.

opportunity.title: Buttah Skin Affiliate Program (Awin)
opportunity.description: Join Buttah Skin on Awin, create skincare routine and results content, and earn commission with a 90-day attribution window; the brand also reviews creator applications on its own partnerships page.
opportunity.compensation_notes: 20% per sale as reported by the Lasso directory; the Awin merchant profile confirms the program and its 90-day cookie but does not print the rate. Commission cap: unknown - no cap statement is published.

reasons.niche_fit: Melanin-focused skincare routines and before/after content are a proven UGC format.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs its own creators page and drives most of its TikTok Shop sales through affiliate creators, showing an active creator engine.
reasons.compensation: 20% per sale is a strong rate, but it is directory-reported rather than printed on the network profile.
reasons.contact_access: Own creators/partnerships application page plus the Awin join route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Awin program plus an open creator application form on the brand site.
reasons.credibility: Established brand founded in 2018; rate rests on a directory listing, so credibility sits one notch below fully verified.

name: Deedee
description: Handmade braided wig brand - every wig is braided by hand, one at a time - running a deliberately small, hand-reviewed creator program with personal links, dashboards and a free custom wig for active creators.

contacts.notes: Applications are made through the brand's own creator program page; every application is read by a person on the team.

evidence.summary: Deedee's own creator program page (fetched) runs the program directly through an UpPromote application: creators get a personal link and dashboard, a free custom HD lace wig every 20 orders, and applications are hand-reviewed with no auto-approvals; the brand states it keeps the program small on purpose. No creator count is published, so saturation is recorded as unknown despite the small-program wording.

The brand's own program page states the earnings term explicitly: 'Every order placed through your link earns you 5% - for as long as it's live, no cap.' That is an explicit no-earnings-cap statement on a fetched brand page, so the cap is recorded as uncapped.

opportunity.title: Deedee Creator Program
opportunity.description: Apply to Deedee's small hand-reviewed creator program, post install and styling content, and earn 5% on every sale through your link with no cap, plus a free custom wig every 20 orders.
opportunity.compensation_notes: 5% commission on every sale (brand's own page). Commission cap: UNCAPPED - the program page states earnings run 'for as long as it's live, no cap.' Creators also receive a free custom HD lace wig every 20 orders.

reasons.niche_fit: Braided wig installs and styling are a focused but highly visual hair-content niche.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Application-based and deliberately small, so acceptance is selective rather than open.
reasons.credibility: Very small handmade brand; terms are verified on its own page but scale and track record are limited.
